# Papercuts — raw-autotune

Small frictions hit while working, logged in the moment (D-027). None of these blocked anything; together they show where the project needs sanding down. Newest first.

- 2026-08-09 [codex] The first focused cargo test invocation passed two positional test filters, which Cargo rejects; reran with the shared module filter.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.the-first-focused-cargo-test-invocation-passed/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] ImageMagick crop review composition initially put +append before its input images; the CLI reports no images found and requires the operator after the input list.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.imagemagick-crop-review-composition-initially/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] ImageMagick compare returns exit status 1 when images differ even though it successfully reports RMSE; metric-only review commands need to tolerate that expected status.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.imagemagick-compare-returns-exit-status-1-when/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] FFF multi_grep still closes its transport when searching the harmonic highlight code, so discovery again fell back to rg after the required FFF-first attempt.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.fff-multi-grep-still-closes-its-transport-when/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] FFF find_files again closed its transport while locating the requested review RAWs, forcing a filesystem fallback before a time-sensitive render run.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.fff-find-files-again-closed-its-transport-while/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] Cargo test accepts one positional TESTNAME filter, so attempting to name two exact tests in one invocation fails before compilation; run the filters as separate commands.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.cargo-test-accepts-one-positional-testname/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] akr revise --from help describes a replacement body, but a plain-text body fails AKR-C031 because the file must parse as a complete record; the required record wrapper is not shown in revise help.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.akr-revise-from-help-describes-a-replacement/1`
- 2026-08-09 [codex] AKR get shows a record key and revision but not its source path or an exportable replacement body; locating the sealed head for akr revise --from required an extra filesystem layout check.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.akr-get-shows-a-record-key-and-revision-but-not/1`
- 2026-08-08 [codex] While running three targeted Rust tests I passed multiple test filters to one cargo test invocation; Cargo accepts only one positional filter. Retried with a shared substring/full suite; an error hint mentioning this limitation would reduce the small loop.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.while-running-three-targeted-rust-tests-i/1`
- 2026-08-08 [claude] The unit tests that pinned the da23c5f near-white anchor rule were kept by name and docstring while their bodies were relaxed to weaker claims (exact channel equality became "spread should not grow much"; a test named near_white_reconstruction_is_independent_of_strength gained a comment saying near-white pixels now do vary with strength). The suite stayed green through a visible rendering regression. Worth a convention: when a rewrite makes a pinned invariant false, delete the test and say so in the changelog rather than editing its body under its old name.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.the-unit-tests-that-pinned-the-da23c5f-near/1`
- 2026-08-08 [codex] The full batch process stopped at the execution harness's ~30-second lifetime, initially resembling another OOM. Inspection found 28 images already written incrementally and no surviving process; bounded restart with skip-existing is required for long validation runs in this environment.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.the-full-batch-process-stopped-at-the-execution/1`
- 2026-08-08 [codex] Re-running stage dumps into an explicit `/tmp` diagnostic directory was rejected because the command contained `rm -rf`; using a fresh `mktemp -d` directory avoids the cleanup and is safer.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.re-running-stage-dumps-into-an-explicit-tmp/1`
- 2026-08-08 [codex] knowledge.context rejects a completed work record even when a follow-up scoping task needs its full history; the error does not suggest the nearest active related record.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.knowledge-context-rejects-a-completed-work/1`
- 2026-08-08 [codex] `grade_sky.py` reported zero pairs on a normal recursive batch output because rendered files were nested under the input directory name; the tool does not recurse or point the user to the discovered child directory.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.grade-sky-py-reported-zero-pairs-on-a-normal/1`
- 2026-08-08 [codex] Forwarding six full-resolution diagnostic PNGs through the image viewer exceeded the IPC frame limit; making a downscaled montage first is required, but the limit is only reported after all images are loaded.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.forwarding-six-full-resolution-diagnostic-pngs/1`
- 2026-08-08 [codex] A two-frame --lens-correction profile-exact render was killed after decode: the job-memory planner does not yet account for simultaneous RGB and clip-confidence resampling buffers. Retrying the diagnostic at --jobs 1 avoids the peak; the planner should budget profiled lens correction before this mode can graduate from opt-in.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.a-two-frame-lens-correction-profile-exact/1`
- 2026-08-08 [codex] A release build invocation returned without Cargo's Finished line and left the previous binary in place, so the first batch gate rejected the new --lens-correction flag. Retrying the build explicitly and verifying --help before the batch; tooling should surface the subprocess exit status when output is handed off through a cell.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.a-release-build-invocation-returned-without/1`
- 2026-08-07 [fugu] knowledge.search and knowledge.start via the akr MCP tool repeatedly failed with FTS5 errors (e.g. "fts5: syntax error near ','" on a comma-containing query, and "no such column: default" on the query 'HDR slice 6 non-default feature'). Queries with bare punctuation or reserved-looking words need escaping/quoting, or the tool should sanitise them. Fell back to grepping .akr/records directly.  `@raw-autotune.papercut.knowledge-search-and-knowledge-start-via-the/1`
